newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH METROSTAV WINS SLOVAK TUNNEL ORDER.
newsitem.headline: CZECH METROSTAV WINS SLOVAK TUNNEL ORDER.

text.p: The Czech construction company Metrostav a.s. said on Friday that it had won a 55 million crown contract to cooperate on the rebuilding of a rail tunnel in Slovakia.

"It means a subcontracting contract in the amount of 55 million crowns for the repair of the Telgart tunnel. The contruction work should begin in June of this year," Metrostav general director Jindrich Hess told a news conference.

Last year Metrostav, which built Prague's underground transport system, the Metro, established a Slovak subsidiary, Metrostav-Slovakia, and is cooperating with Doprastavem Slovakia, general contractor on a major motorway in the country.

Hess said Metrostav is interested in possible construction contracts on motorways, highways, and tunnels in Slovakia, as well as on a new metropolitan underground transport system which the city of Bratislava has under consideration.
